name: Store
_comment: BananaOS's Store catalog (rocknixds-store reads it with RNDS_STORE_PLATFORM=banana). Paths are ROCKNIX's, mapped by the Store: /storage/.config/rocknixds/<id> -> /data/store/apps/<id>, the tile folder -> /data/store/tiles. Döda Kvarter and Bank come with the system ("builtin": removing one takes its tile off the menu, installing puts it back), and so does the Store.

apps.name: eReaderDS
apps.summary: A two-page ebook reader: hold the handheld sideways like an open book.
apps.description: Each screen shows one page. Reads EPUB and text books, and comics and manga (.cbz). Bookmarks, highlights, a dictionary, themes and fonts, KOReader sync, and books from Standard Ebooks, Project Gutenberg and other catalogs, or sent from your phone or computer over Wi-Fi. Put books in roms/ebook on the card (the banana share's roms\ebook folder); your books, settings and reading places stay there, also when the app is removed. Made by casualducko for the RG DS Plus; it updates itself too, and the Store follows its releases.

apps.name: Döda Kvarter
apps.summary: A zombie roguelike for both screens, set in a Swedish suburb at night.
apps.description: Survive round after round as in Call of Duty Zombies: earn kronor, buy your way through barricades into new districts, find the power, drink Julmust and Snabbkaffe, try Lådan (beware the Dalahäst) and upgrade at Smedjan. Every town is new and the loot gets better every round. Eight bosses from Swedish folklore. The top screen is the game, the bottom screen your inventory, health, ammo and the map. It comes with BananaOS: removing it takes its tile off the menu (your saves stay in apps/dodakvarter on the card), installing it puts the tile back.

apps.name: Bank & Trade
apps.summary: A Pokémon bank, legality checker and trading app, built on PKHeX.Core.
apps.description: Reads your game saves (generation 1 to 5), stores Pokémon in boxes of its own, moves them between games through the bank (they change format only when they move up a generation, as Pal Park and Poké Transfer did), checks every one with PKHeX's legality analysis, and trades with another handheld over Wi-Fi, in a lobby or a private room. Close the game before you use it. It comes with BananaOS: removing it takes its tile off the menu (your bank stays in apps/bank on the card), installing it puts the tile back.
